extracted.name: Tex-Mex Migas Recipe
extracted.description: This Tex-Mex migas recipe is one of my favorite breakfasts! I scramble eggs with crushed tortilla chips, fresh veggies, and melty cheese. Serve with tortillas and avocado so you can assemble tacos as you eat!
ingredient_lines: ½ to 1 jalapeño pepper (stemmed and diced)
½ cup shredded Monterey jack cheese
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, tomato, jalapeño, garlic, salt, and several grinds of pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring, or until softened. Add the eggs and crumbled chips and stir to scramble. Stir in the cheese and remove from the heat. Season to taste.
Divide the migas between two plates and sprinkle with the cilantro. Serve with the tortillas, avocado slices, lime wedges, and salsa.
